events.text: Morning aicoo, Q3 revenue target is 2.4 million USD, just finalized with Grace.
Reminder: Ben's Q3 target is 500k in new sales.
Ravi的team要在September 15前finish那个integration，tight deadline啊。
aicoo, remind me to send Q3 budget breakdown to Grace by Friday.
好的，我会在Friday前remind you to send那份budget breakdown.
Lily刚confirm了，那enterprise deal worth 800k, 客户是Aurora Health。
Yuki redesign了onboarding flow，AB test shows 23% conversion lift, impressive.
aicoo, 帮我和Omar说一声，I'll review his Singapore pipeline next Monday.
Got it, 我会通知Omar你next Monday要review他的pipeline.
aicoo, don't forget to remind me to check Ravi's integration progress on Sep 1.
Sure, I'll remind you on Sep 1 about Ravi的integration progress.
Booked flight to Singapore for Sep 1, need to visit Omar's team那边。
Omar said his Singapore team's budget increased by 15% for Q4.
老爸又进医院了，schedule for this week完全被打乱，Ben take over the pricing review.
Just got pricing model v2 from Ben, plan to launch 39 per user per month.
aicoo, PR descriptions以后always end with a Risk section.
Lily说Aurora deal可能会有scope change，要加custom analytics module.
Ben的pricing review meeting moved to next Wednesday.
Customer interview里有3家requested dark mode，记下来给Yuki。
aicoo, from now on call me 凯哥 instead of Kai.
Got it, 凯哥. I'll use that from now on.
Ravi confirmed integration rollout delayed to Sep 22，因为security audit。
Flew to Singapore today, meeting Omar and two enterprise prospects。
Grace想见Yuki关于new UX mockups, scheduled for Oct 5.
季度roadmap review with Grace, 把dark mode priority提到P1。
aicoo, 提醒我下周二和Yuki sync dark mode feedback.
没问题，下周二我会remind you sync with Yuki on dark mode feedback.
aicoo, schedule a meeting with Ben to finalize pricing by Oct 15.
Done, meeting with Ben scheduled for Oct 15 on pricing finalization.
Ben proposed pricing change to 49 per user for premium tier, v3 now。
Lily asked for two days off next week, Oct 6-7.
New hire for PM role, first candidate Jason Chen interviewed, 8 years exp.
Sent that Q3 budget breakdown to Grace, finally done.
Lily update: Aurora deal pushed to Q4 close, value now 950k with add-ons。
Daughter's school play tonight, 我得早点走.
Ravi的新hire start date delayed to Nov 15.
周报里加一段本周踩的坑，aicoo记住这个format.
Second PM candidate Emily Tan interviewed, strong in B2B, 6 years exp。
aicoo, reviewed Omar's Singapore pipeline today, good progress.
Yuki finished dark mode mockups, 需要engineering estimate by next week。
老爸情况稳定了，我可以focus on Aurora negotiations again。
Customer survey里80% want better mobile support.
Q3 revenue hit 2.1M so far, tracking slightly below target, Grace要review。
Third PM candidate Michael Liu interviewed, 10 years, ex-Microsoft.
aicoo, 以后回复别用bullet points, just plain text.
Understood, I'll reply without bullet points going forward.
Pricing final decision: 44 per user per month, launch Nov 1, after debate with Ben。
Dark mode design review with Yuki done, two iterations needed.
Flew back to Shanghai, Omar说Singapore pipeline healthy, 5 new leads。
Ravi confirmed integration went live Sep 22, 延迟了但还算顺利。
Omar提到Singapore office needs 3 new sales hires by year-end.
Grace asked me to present Q4 roadmap on Oct 10, Friday. 要准备deck。
aicoo, meeting minutes以后开头加个 summary sentence on decisions.
Aurora contract signed, 950k deal closed, Lily和我庆祝了一下。
Engineering team的velocity up 20% this sprint, Ravi reports.
Yuki的dark mode implementation started, target mid-Nov release。
Yuki wants to test dark mode with 50 beta users next week.
Hired Emily Tan as PM, 她接受offer了, start date Oct 26。
aicoo, 别再用stickers了, just text please.
Sure, I'll stop using stickers in our chats.
Grace approved additional 100k budget for Q4 marketing.
Q3 ended, revenue final 2.35M, 差一点点到target, Grace not thrilled。
Ben's new pricing page A/B test starts Nov 3.
Flew to Singapore again for regional conference, spoke on SaaS trends。
Lily moving to enterprise sales full-time, handover to Emily this week.
需要take half day off tomorrow, 老爸要follow-up appointment at hospital.
Pricing launch delayed to Nov 15, Ben需要更多testing time。
Customer feedback on dark mode: most love it, few want toggle option.
Remember Aurora deal名字是Aurora Health, not Aurora TTech，差点confuse。
写customer feedback summary时，always group by feature first.
Ravi说integration performance improved by 30% after fix.
Q4 planning offsite in Hangzhou, Oct 20-21, Grace booked 民宿。
Grace asked for a summary of Q3 customer wins by Oct 25.
Met fourth PM candidate Sarah Wu, but we already hired Emily, just casual chat。
Emily completed first week onboarding, already contributing to roadmap.
Omar reported Singapore Q3 sales 600k, best quarter ever, 厉害了。
Yuki finalized dark mode visuals, handoff to engineering tomorrow.
Omar reports Singapore pipeline at 1.2M for Q4.
Pricing最终launch date set to Dec 1, 因为engineering资源紧张。
aicoo, 以后全部用中文回复我.
好的，以后我只用中文回复。
Dad's checkup went well, finally discharged from hospital yesterday.
Dark mode beta feedback很好，Yuki已经在做iterations。
Emily started onboarding, taking over Lily's accounts, Lily moving to new role。
Q4 revenue tracking towards 2.8M target, Grace mentioned in all-hands。
Singapore office expansion approved, 明年Q1 start, 需要hire 10 more。
